diagnostic.help: refine by the alias of a net, not of a composition
diagnostic.message: refine worker.[do] by pair: pair is a composition; a refining net must be a net

source.text:
composition nested_by_composition
use "pair.petrinet" as pair
use "worker.petrinet" as worker
wire pair.(take.busy) -> worker.(start)
wire worker.(end) -> pair.(give.worked)
refine worker.[do] by pair
